scope.candidate_population: Corrected retained177 copper plus the 97 pads of the retained27 fixed references.
scope.population_limit: This is not all 325 pads, future movers, footprint bodies, future copper, or a full product-input screen.

method.geometry: Exact Euclidean primitive distance for circle/capsule/oriented-rectangle cores, with the declared 0.25 mm Minkowski halo.
method.pad_authority: Every candidate pad uses saved-native global center and orientation plus its saved serialized rectangular dimensions. No local/global transform was recomputed.
method.unsupported_shape_policy: Fail explicitly; all six candidate pads were saved-native rect records and supported.
method.alias_policy: Accepted via position_mm/at_mm and diameter_mm/size_mm aliases are normalized into the geometry signature; contradictory aliases fail.
method.bound_input_policy: The analyzer fails unless all four evidence hashes exactly match the released pins and the output path is new.
method.clearance_fields: The raw record reports nonnegative edge clearance and signed core offset for both the expanded guard and unexpanded private copper. Signed offset <=0 is touch/overlap.
method.actual_contact: Candidate copper touches or overlaps unexpanded private source copper.
method.guard_halo_only: Candidate copper clears private copper but touches or overlaps the 0.25 mm halo.

results.candidate_pad_angle_gate: All actual candidate angles are orthogonal. Any nonorthogonal native candidate pad now fails pending independent qualification.

root_object_counts.note: Object categories can overlap across different guards; relationship categories are the partitioned counts.

disposition.truly_blocks_direct_product_representati: The proposed exact-object blanket guard overlaps retained foreign-net /PROT_DOUT track 1c54fc7b... at the R27.2 halo, despite 0.212066 mm actual copper clearance. It also covers six additional retained same-net GND objects beyond the two already reviewed boundary joins. A direct no-track/no-pad guard representation therefore remains unresolved; no intrusion is waived or carved out here.
disposition.not_an_electrical_clearance_failure: The sole foreign-net relationship is a halo representation conflict, not actual copper contact: 0.212066 mm is greater than the selected 0.20 mm minimum.
disposition.same_net_topology_unresolved: This supplement does not decide whether the six other GND objects bypass either private path; that remains root topology disposition.
disposition.broad_phase_disposition: Fourteen of 46 AABB relationships are analytic guard false positives.
disposition.preserved_duties: Retained177 and all PROT_COUT restoration duties remain unchanged.

independent_known_coordinate_cases: boolean overlap versus tangent versus small positive gap

attempts.result: Corrected alias-safe supplement; relationship array byte-structure equivalent after JSON load.

limits: This static result does not qualify native KiCad or Quilter guard serialization or enforcement.
The accepted narrow plane-control f602de4 is not rerun and its three attempts remain exhausted.
No product input, product grounding, routing, manufacturing, supplier, or child-use acceptance is claimed.

The upstream candidate generator still transforms non-private pads with the invalid footprint rotation sign. The46 checked relationships are useful, but absence from that list does not establish clearance for all97 fixed pads.

root_review.timing_note: The17:42 target was exceeded during discovery and documentation of an upstream candidate-completeness gap; no further executor run was requested in this item.
root_review.accepted_scope: Exact analytic outcomes for the enumerated46 relationships only. Corrected code, immutable snapshots, raw/receipt hashes and full relationship-array equality were reviewed.

upstream_defect.finding: Only four private pads use saved-native poses. Other fixed pads used for candidate generation still use the old positive-angle local-to-global transform.
upstream_defect.witnesses: R26.1 and C28.1 appear near opposite private pads in the old broad phase; the new narrow phase correctly uses their actual saved-native centers.
upstream_defect.unaffected: The twelve-object private guard definition and this enumerated narrow-phase geometry remain source-bound; potential omitted obstacle pairs are not qualified.

baseline_topology_reuse.finding: The prior native proof already places a2730cca-to-78dc0310 contact wholly within C28.2. The two other newly enumerated actual GND contacts are with C28.2 itself; the other three GND relationships are halo-only. These observations are not evidence of a newly introduced bypass.
baseline_topology_reuse.limit: This reuses unchanged-source evidence, not future routing or full candidate-population acceptance.

root_review.DOUT_disposition: Keep the existing route. Its0.212066mm copper gap exceeds the0.20mm comparison minimum; the0.25mm prospective guard creates a representation conflict, not an electrical short or clearance defect.
root_review.next_item: Rebuild and audit conservative candidate coverage from all97 saved-native fixed-pad poses/bounds and retained177 copper before any all-population clearance claim.
